tips.text: Run Lephantis in a public squad; someone will delete him fast.
Bring a fast-firing, multishot weapon such as the Kohm; one huge shot is wasted on his damage cap.
Shoot only the pink weak spots shown while a head attacks; everything else is immune.
Slow him with Molecular Prime, Rhino Stomp, Snow Globe or Temporal Drag to widen the weak-spot windows.
Leave and re-gear if a solo run passes about 10 minutes; undergeared solo runs take 30 or more.
Use punch-through so shots reach a revealed weak spot through the rest of his body.
Use heat plus viral or corrosive and skip status weapons; his status procs are largely wasted.
Skip melee unless you can reach a revealed weak spot mid-air.
Kill any Juggernaut you spawned before entering; it follows you into the arena.
Skip Mesa's Peacemaker here; it targets center mass, not weak points.
Hose the Infested Corpus head the moment it surfaces in phase 1; it appears rarely once the other two are down.
Do not sell Nekros for a slot expecting an easy re-farm; one player was 18 runs deep with no Neuroptics.
Start all three part builds at the same time so the frame build can begin sooner.
Expect a couple of evenings; 18 to 28 runs for one part is normal tail luck, not a bug.
Players call this one of the mild frame farms once you can kill Lephantis in 3 to 5 minutes.
